comment: Lookup table of allowed course content types (e.g. Introduction, Lecture, Announcement).

columns.name: code
columns.comment: Stable, short, machine-facing code for the content type.

columns.name: display_name
columns.comment: Human-readable label for the content type.

columns.name: sort_order
columns.comment: Explicit presentation order for this content type, independent of code or alphabetical order.

columns.name: is_active
columns.comment: Whether this content type is available for new selections. Retiring a value doesn't invalidate rows that already reference it.
